environment.rules: Mapped groves, street allees, clearance-tested shared courts; all scenario parcels/routes and people spots reserved.

architecture.source: Original parts placed on attributed source facade edges; no added building count.

landmarks.name: Nur Alem · EXPO
landmarks.description: A blue sphere, a glass lattice and petal-shaped pavilions.

landmarks.name: Baiterek
landmarks.description: A golden sphere held in white branches above the city.

landmarks.name: Khan Shatyr
landmarks.description: A tilted mast, a translucent tent and a broad base.

landmarks.name: Palace of Peace and Reconciliation
landmarks.description: A stone pyramid crowned with light-filled glass.

landmarks.name: Akorda
landmarks.description: White colonnades, a blue dome and a golden spire.

landmarks.name: Hazret Sultan Mosque
landmarks.description: Pale domes, arcades and four slender minarets.

landmarks.name: Astana Opera
landmarks.description: A grand portico, columns and a quadriga above the pediment.

landmarks.name: Mangilik El
landmarks.description: A triumphal arch with niches, reliefs and cornices.

landmarks.name: Qazaqstan Concert Hall
landmarks.description: Curved blue walls unfold like a flower.

landmarks.name: Atyrau Bridge
landmarks.description: An intricate scale-like canopy above a pedestrian bridge over the Esil.

landmarks.name: Abu Dhabi Plaza
landmarks.description: Stepped glass towers rise above the city.

landmarks.name: Astana Grand Mosque
landmarks.description: A blue dome, four minarets and an open courtyard with arcades.

landmarks.name: Bridges over the Esil
landmarks.description: Two distinct arched structures: one for trains and one for a city avenue.

landmarks.name: Tarlan Astana · LRT
landmarks.description: Silver stations and turquoise trains follow the real route.

metadata.projection: Local planar city; center 71.431,51.139; x 5.8, y 9.25 per degree; source height_m and base_m at uniform 1/12000 metre scale, without artificial height relief
metadata.representation: Complete resident city: identical indexed geometry at every camera scale
